name: Frog Jump
description: Are you bored? Then it's time to do something fun. Play Frog Jump, a free online platform jumping game inspired by Mario. This game is a classic retro platformer. Jump, run, and don't stop until you reach the end! If you're looking for cool games, you've found them. Frog Jump is a free online platform jumping game. Don't fall through the levels and don't fall into the water. Jump on the platforms to get higher and higher, but don't fall, as that's game over!
